subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are seated around a round table, facing the center. B sits second to the right of D. C is an immediate neighbor of A and B. E sits immediate right of G. How many people sit between F and B, when counted from the left of F?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are sitting around a circular table facing the center.

1. B sits second to the right of D.
2. C is an immediate neighbour of both A and B.
3. E sits immediately to the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e24debe9dc2fd892a96caeda08a9bc6a24144dd73a62568d8805f40d2fda017.png] 

F, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/309955584ed40bd76a4711ca31c810910d805d8283f679cff84edd15fb9eb0b7.png] 

Thus, five persons are sitting between F and B when counted from the left of F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
